payload.note: Contact-quotient's canonical computation uses the electroglottographic (EGG) signal: the contact phase is extracted from the EGG waveform via derivative zero crossings, and the quotient is the contact-phase duration divided by T0. The definition states the signal source is 'the electroglottographic or glottal-flow signal', but EGG is the primary modality — it is the direct measurement of vocal-fold contact that the parameter quantifies. Removing electroglottography as a capability would eliminate the direct measurement modality for this parameter; the parameter would lose its primary operational definition and relegate itself to an indirect glottal-flow approximation.

Filing judged as one (Law 5, Amendment 17). [1 made] scope: a quantifier of the noise/harmonic energy balance, built to persist as a standardized clinical measure of vocal hyperfunction — a reason, not a category. [2 referent] THING, the made parameter; carve fits. [3 name] noise-to-harmonics-ratio: the name is free on the live record (precheck: held only by this provisional filing); it is the reciprocal statistic of the accepted HNR holder (10 log10(noise/harmonic) vs 10 log10(harmonic/noise)) — the board read the HNR/GNR pair as distinct clinical parameters, and this is not a self-labeled restatement of an accepted entry. [4 not a duplicate] verified on the live graph: no accepted holder of any noise-to-harmonic* name. [5 carving] STFT noise-band over harmonic-band energy ratio in dB, parameters (1) segment/window, (2) band decomposition, (3) reference/averaging; persistence: standardized clinical parameter, self-declares maintained membership in the voice-quality measurement map — the self-declared-family class the board upheld. [6 trailer] ratio rumoris ad harmonicam is Latinate, not the English restated; substrate mind, horizon a life, explicit yes — each field answers. [7 examples] real clinical uses (nodule sustained-vowel study; muscle-tension dysphonia protocol); near-misses shimmer and jitter fall outside the carve.

ADVANCE on all 7 items.

1. Made: The scope states why humans made noise-to-harmonics-ratio — to quantify noise energy relative to harmonic energy as a standardized clinical measure of vocal hyperfunction. This is a functional purpose, not a bare category label. [1 made]
2. Referent: THING is correct. NHR is a human-made acoustic parameter, an abstract construct for measurement. The carving fits a THING. [2 referent]
3. Name: noise-to-harmonics-ratio is a noun naming the construct. I checked the map and it is not held by another accepted entry.
4. Not a duplicate: This sense (a clinical acoustic parameter measuring noise/harmonic energy ratio) is distinct from other accepted entries. The nearest existing entries (jitter, shimmer, voice-quality) are different parameters or parameter families.
5. Carving: The definition states the parameters (voice segment/window length, harmonic/noise band decomposition via FFT, reference level/averaging) and the persistence mechanism (standardized clinical parameter maintained as a member of the voice-quality measurement map). The computation (noise energy / harmonic energy from STFT) is consistent and real.
6. Trailer: formal 'ratio rumoris ad harmonicam' is Latin, not an English restatement. substrate: mind (it is a parameter/measure). horizon: a life (the construct persists as a clinical standard). explicit: yes (it is exactly what it claims to be).
7. Examples: The two examples are real clinical uses — a 50-ms segment in a vocal-fold nodule study and a 100-ms segment in a laryngeal muscle-tension dysphonia protocol. Near-misses (shimmer; jitter) are distinct perturbation parameters that fall outside the carve of noise energy ratio.

The filing's own carve names no distinguishing parameter; 10log10(N/H) is the sign-inverted form of 10log10(H/N), one construct filed under a second name, and glottal-to-noise-ratio (e7d771115e2c7242d789ae0b1) shows the court has already admitted this quantity once under another name. Item 4 fails. The examples are restatements: 'noise-to-harmonics ratio computed from a 50-ms segment...' names the entry's own construct as its instance, a generic measurement act with no named study, standard, protocol, or implementation, so the clause cites nothing real and the definition leans on it to pin a sense it never pins (the two band decompositions it allows are HNR's own parameters) - items 5 and 7 fail together. Near-misses (shimmer, jitter) are outside the carve and are not the defect. Items 1, 2, 3 pass; 6's values are within the arguable range (horizon a life is defensible for a maintained clinical parameter). One construct, two accepted names already on the map; the filing strikes whole.
